name: sift-strands-spikes
description: Throwaway feasibility spikes for four never-used @strands-agents/sdk features (HITL interrupt/resume, Cedar authorization, A2A round-trip, LLM steering + custom context provider) plus a MemoryManager smoke check. Not part of the pnpm workspace (see root pnpm-workspace.yaml, which globs only apps/* and packages/*) -- this directory has its own standalone node_modules installed via npm so the Cedar/A2A optional peer deps (not installed at the workspace root) do not touch the tracked pnpm-lock.yaml.
